description: This file contains test code for the WebRTC client in the project, including test cases for initial message sending and answer generation, as well as some utility functions and a test observer struct.

classes.name: TestObserver
classes.description: A struct implementing methods to observe WebRTC DataChannel events and errors within tests.

methods.name: OnADBDataChannel
methods.description: Callback for handling new DataChannel events.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Callback for handling close event, reports connection closed error.

methods.name: OnFailure
methods.description: Callback for handling failure event, reports connection failure.

methods.name: recvWithTimeOut
methods.description: A generic function to receive a message from a channel with a timeout, and reshape it to a specific type.

methods.name: TestClientSendsInitialMessage
methods.description: Test to verify the client sends an initial request-offer message within a timeout period.

methods.name: TestClientGeneratesAnswer
methods.description: Test to verify that the client responds with an answer when an offer is received, within a timeout period.
